title: Twitter and GDPR
body:
It seems that the bridge for Twitter won't work in the EU because of GDPR - I'm seeing this message:

\n
By using Twitter’s services you agree to our Cookie Use and Data Transfer outside the EU. We and our partners operate globally and use cookies, including for analytics, personalisation, and ads.

in my feed.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
I don't see it. Bridge is located in Moscow.
https://feed.eugenemolotov.ru/dev/?action=display&bridge=Twitter&q=Kekeflipnote&format=Html

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body: eu law cookie policy not in the russian

comments.author: Participant 4
comments.body: The bridge is working fine on my machine (located in Germany). Is this an isolated incident for one specific query or a general problem? Can you provide one of your failing queries?

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: It seems to have stopped appending messages to Twitter now.

comments.author: Participant 4
comments.body:
I see, thanks for letting us know :+1: 
I'll close this issue now. Feel free to reopen if the problem returns.

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
